Laughter from the man is audible in the background. (3) A montage of audio clips features various song genres, from melancholic ballads to high-energy dance tracks. The boy's vocals alternate between soft singing and enthusiastic shouting. Cartoon-style ping and whoosh SFXs are interspersed between cuts. (4) Interaction audio includes the man and boy talking and laughing. The man's tone is warm and encouraging, while the boy sounds playful. The BGM continues throughout, providing a consistent musical bed across the fragmented vocal clips. (5) In the final phases, the boy attempts to sing phonetically in multiple languages including Korean and English. The vocal arousal is high as they reach high-pitched climaxes. The audio concludes with clapping sounds and the man's approving exclamation.
